notes:
Inbound trial from product listing (Feb 10). SMB support tooling vendor focused on small-mid ecomm sellers. Short notes from discovery call:
- Wants: reliable short ticket summaries (1-2 sentence) + JSON structured output for routing and SLA tag assignment.
- Emphasis on tool-calling: run outbound webhook to internal triage service and receive structured status.
- "We need something that can run on a tight budget and slot into Zendesk workflows." (customer).
- Prefer hosted, no immediate plan for private/VPC. Very cost sensitive.
- Asked about model version pinning and ability to fallback to smaller models when spikes happen.
- Request: sample latency and per-ticket cost estimates for 10k / 30k / 100k monthly tickets.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for admin login, audit logs for each API call.
- POC plan: upload 7-day sample, compare Redwood hosted API vs competitor baseline on summary accuracy and cost.
- Sales note: good candidate for self-serve -> convert if ARR projection <$20k/year and clear ROI on agent-time saved.

throughput_targets: 10-20 rps sustained during daytime; bursts to 50 rps for peak events
sales_notes: SMB inbound. Likely to convert via self-serve if POC shows low per-ticket cost and easy integration with Zendesk webhook actions. Offer 60-day credits and quickstart script for anonymized ingestion.
technical_notes: Concerned about per-token pricing; asked about prefix caching and batching to reduce cost. Wants example config for continuous batching and max_wait thresholds. Wants to see QoS when switching to smaller quantized models.

Can you show a JSON schema we can use to route tickets automatically?
